purpose: Teach: 多かれ/暮し/所々/苛立ち/うかがえる/真中/縮め/探し出し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人は多かれ少なかれ寂しさを感じるのよ
lines.en: Sho — everyone feels loneliness in their own way, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, measured tone. Soft opening. Speaks with the tenderness of someone sharing something true. Unhurried pace, like she's offering this thought rather than explaining it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと一緒の暮しが大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really love living with Dad.
lines.style: Bright and sincere. No performance. A small, genuine statement of fact delivered with quiet certainty. Voice steady, warm. The certainty of a child who knows what he means.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお部屋に所々埃が積もってるわね
lines.en: Sho — there's dust gathering in corners of your dad's room, isn't there.
lines.style: Observational, not critical. Soft noticing. Slight pause before speaking, like she's deciding whether to say it gently. The voice of someone who sees small details others miss.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、苛立ちを抑える練習してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm practicing not getting frustrated, you know.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to himself. Matter-of-fact without defensiveness. The voice of a child doing something hard and not asking for credit. Simple, direct delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお顔から疲れがうかがえるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad looks tired, doesn't he. I can see it in his face.
lines.style: Thoughtful, with care underneath. Not pitying — observing with affection. Slow enough to let the concern land. The voice of someone noticing what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、公園の真中で遊ぼうよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — let's go play in the middle of the park!
lines.style: Sudden brightness. Energy shift up. Eager but not desperate — a child redirecting with genuine invitation. Quick, light attack on the opening word.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、長いお話を短く縮めて伝えるのも上手ね
lines.en: Sho — you're really good at taking long stories and making them short, aren't you.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Genuine praise, not performed. Noticing something real about him. Voice steady, sincere. A moment of seeing him clearly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、無くしたおもちゃを探し出したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Mei-sis found the toy you lost!
lines.style: Bright triumph without boasting. Quick, pleased delivery. The eagerness of a child bringing good news. Opening attack is light and happy. Voice bounces slightly on the ending.
